instructions.name: apply_change
docs: Apply a loosening change once the chain clock reaches `effective_at`.

instructions.name: cancel_change
docs: Drop a loosening change. Owner or guardian.

instructions.name: charge
docs: Submit a charge. Signed by the agent, decided by this program.
Returns Ok whether the charge is paid or refused. See the module doc
for why a refusal must not be an error.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent holds authority and nothing else. It is not the owner, it
pays only the transaction fee, and it cannot change any limit.

instructions.name: close_hold_vault
docs: Close an idle, unfrozen vault to its stored safe address.

instructions.name: close_mandate
docs: Reclaim rent once a mandate is finished. Only the owner, never while active.

instructions.name: close_trade_rule
docs: Reclaim rent once a trade rule is finished or past expiry, and revoke
any delegation the source still gives the rule.

accounts.name: source
docs: still a token account delegated to this rule, close revokes that.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Move tokens into the vault token account.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Pay a held withdrawal once the chain clock reaches its unlock time.

instructions.name: freeze
docs: Block every outflow except `recover`. Owner or guardian.

instructions.name: grant_override
docs: Let one specific charge through above the per-payment ceiling.
The owner signs, so the override is explicit. It is written to the
ledger, so it is on the record. It raises the per-payment ceiling only:
the total cap stays absolute.

instructions.name: grant_trade_override
docs: Raise the per-trade ceiling for one nonce. The daily limit and the cap stay put.

instructions.name: init_vault
docs: Open a Hold vault. The vault PDA is the authority of its token account.

instructions.name: migrate_hold_vault
docs: Upgrade the previous Hold layout without relaxing any stored rule.

instructions.name: open_mandate
docs: Open a mandate and delegate `cap` to it in the same transaction, so the
owner signs exactly once.

instructions.name: open_trade_rule
docs: Open a trade rule and delegate `cap` of the input token account to it.

instructions.name: propose_change
docs: Tighten a rule now. A looser rule waits out the current delay.

instructions.name: recover
docs: Send the whole vault balance to the safe address. Works while frozen.

instructions.name: revoke_mandate
docs: Withdraw the agent's authority immediately, in one owner signature.
Allowed from any status except already REVOKED, so an EXPIRED or
EXHAUSTED mandate can still drop its SPL delegation. A second revoke
is refused.

instructions.name: revoke_trade_rule
docs: Withdraw the agent's authority. Allowed from any status except revoked.

instructions.name: skip
docs: Pay a held withdrawal before its unlock time. Both keys, and not while frozen.

instructions.name: stop
docs: Cancel one held withdrawal. Owner or guardian, with no wait.

instructions.name: trade
docs: Sell `amount_in` of the pinned input through the pinned pool.
Returns Ok whether the trade is filled or refused.

instructions.name: unfreeze
docs: Clear a freeze. Both keys, or the owner alone after the delay when no guardian is set.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Pay `amount` now when the rules allow it. Otherwise record a hold.

types.name: Entry
docs: One decision, paid or refused, exactly as the program made it.
`repr(C)` with explicit padding, because the ledger is a zero-copy account:
the ring is larger than the BPF stack frame and must never be deserialized
onto it.

fields.name: suggested_override
docs: For a refusal, the one-shot override that would have cleared this exact
charge, or zero when no override could. A decline that tells you how to
proceed is the difference between a limit and an answer.

types.name: HoldChange
docs: The desired rules, passed whole to `propose_change`.

types.name: HoldClosed
docs: Full token balance swept to the safe token account before closure.

types.name: HoldMigrated
docs: Rent top-up in lamports. No vault tokens move during layout migration.

types.name: HoldVault
docs: Funds live in the vault token account. Its authority is this PDA, so a
raw transfer signed by the owner or the guardian cannot move them.

fields.name: guardian
docs: `Pubkey::default()` means no guardian is set.

fields.name: safe_address
docs: Wallet that must own the token account `recover` pays.

fields.name: window_spent
docs: Unused legacy fixed-window fields, retained to preserve account layout.

fields.name: unfreeze_at
docs: When no guardian is set, `unfreeze` arms this timestamp and finishes
only once the chain clock reaches it. Zero means no unfreeze is waiting.

fields.name: daily_buckets
docs: Rolling daily and share accounting, retaining the current and preceding 24 hours.
Appended so all existing field offsets remain stable.

types.name: Ledger
docs: A ring of the most recent decisions. Refusals are recorded here with the
same weight as payments, which is the point of the whole program.
The ring is the authoritative recent window. Longer history is rebuilt by
indexing `Paid` and `Refused` events from transaction logs, so a busy week
wrapping the ring costs nothing.

fields.name: total
docs: Total entries ever written, including those the ring has overwritten.

fields.name: head
docs: Index the next entry is written to.

types.name: Mandate
docs: A permission to spend, owned by the human and enforced by this program.
The owner key never leaves Seed Vault and signs only `open_mandate`,
`grant_override`, `revoke_mandate` and `close_mandate`. The agent key signs
`charge` and can do nothing else: it cannot widen any limit, change the
merchant, extend the expiry, or move funds outside this account's rules.

fields.name: owner
docs: Human who owns the funds and the mandate.

fields.name: agent
docs: Key allowed to submit charges. Holds authority, never ownership.

fields.name: mint
docs: Asset this mandate governs.

fields.name: source
docs: The owner's token account. Funds stay here until a charge is allowed.

fields.name: merchant
docs: The only wallet that may receive funds under this mandate.

fields.name: mandate_id
docs: Distinguishes several mandates held by the same owner.

fields.name: cap
docs: Total that may ever be spent, in base units.

fields.name: spent
docs: Spent so far, in base units. Never exceeds `cap`.

fields.name: per_tx_max
docs: Largest single payment allowed, in base units.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix seconds after which nothing may be spent.

fields.name: override_amount
docs: One-shot allowance the owner granted for a specific charge.

fields.name: override_nonce
docs: Nonce the override applies to. Zero means no override is pending.

fields.name: last_nonce
docs: Highest nonce that has been paid. Blocks replay of a settled charge.

fields.name: purpose
docs: What the money is for, in the owner's own words, fixed at creation.

fields.name: fields
docs: Which fields wait. See `CHANGE_*`.

types.name: TradeEntry
docs: One trade decision. `repr(C)` with explicit padding, because the ledger is
zero-copy and the ring must never be deserialized onto the stack.
`counterparty` is the pool on a paid trade and on most refusals. On reason
11 or 12 it is the account the agent tried.

types.name: TradeLedger
docs: A ring of the most recent trade decisions, including refusals.

fields.name: total
docs: Total entries ever written, including those the ring has overwritten.

fields.name: head
docs: Index the next entry is written to.

types.name: TradeRule
docs: A permission to swap, owned by the human and enforced by this program.
The owner signs `open_trade_rule`, `grant_trade_override`, `revoke_trade_rule`
and `close_trade_rule`. The agent signs `trade` and can do nothing else.

fields.name: agent
docs: Key allowed to submit trades. Holds authority, never ownership.

fields.name: source
docs: The owner's input token account. Delegated to this rule for `cap`.

fields.name: destination
docs: The owner's output token account, pinned at open.

fields.name: exchange_kind
docs: 0 is the SPL token-swap program named by `SPL_TOKEN_SWAP_ID`.

fields.name: pool_fee_account
docs: Stored at open and compared on every trade. The fee owner is not hardcoded.

fields.name: cap
docs: Total input that may ever be sold, in base units.

fields.name: spent
docs: Input sold so far, in base units. Never exceeds `cap`.

fields.name: per_trade_max
docs: Largest single trade allowed, in base units, before a one-shot override.

fields.name: daily_limit
docs: Most input that may be sold in any rolling 24 hour interval.

fields.name: daily_buckets
docs: Current hour plus the preceding 24 hours. This retains a partial oldest
hour conservatively, so allowance may take up to 25 hours to recover.

fields.name: floor_num
docs: Minimum output per unit of input, as `floor_num / floor_den`.

fields.name: override_amount
docs: One-shot per-trade ceiling the owner granted for a specific nonce.

fields.name: override_nonce
docs: Nonce the override applies to. Zero means no override is pending.

fields.name: last_nonce
docs: Highest nonce that has been traded. A refusal does not advance it.
